card.fires_on: Spaces, numbers and word endings just before a drop count or strength in eye or ear drop directions, such as 'ophthalm|ic', 'one' before 'drop', or the space before '5 drops'.

modes.label: Before a drop count
modes.description: The space or the word 'one' right before a number of drops or a volume to instill.

modes.description: The decimal point or space within a concentration or per-5 mL amount.
